operating_notes.text: Regional Director (NWR) sanctioned the merger of Starbigbloc Building Material Limited into Bigbloc Building Elements Private Limited with appointed date 01.04.2025.
Bigbloc Building Elements Private Limited commenced commercial production at the Umargaon construction chemicals plant.
Average capacity utilisation for Q4 FY26 was around 78% (BBEPL at 89%, Siam Cement Bigbloc at 40%).
Sales volume for Q4 FY26 grew 40% YoY to 2,45,870 cubic meters; full year FY26 volume grew 37% YoY to 8,26,904 cubic meters.
Average capacity utilization reached 78% in Q4 FY26, with BBEPL at 89% and Siam Cement Bigbloc at 40%.
BBEL converted to a public limited company on 17th August 2026.
Starbigbloc Building Material Limited amalgamated into BBEL per order dated 28th April 2026.

timeline.summary: Regional Director sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of Starbigbloc Building Material Limited into Bigbloc Building Elements Private Limited.
Bigbloc Building Elements Private Limited commenced commercial production at its construction chemicals plant at the Umargaon facility.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹86.93 Cr (+34.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹0.89 Cr (-8.2% YoY).
Bigbloc Construction Limited’s **Naresh Sitaram Saboo (Managing Director)** shared the earnings call recording from May 29, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST on the company’s website.
Bigbloc Construction reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹87 Cr with a net loss of ₹1 Cr, alongside earnings call details.
The Board of material subsidiary Bigbloc Building Elements Limited approved an in-principle proposal for an Initial Public Offering.

watchlist.response: Decline was driven by pricing pressure (5-6%) and increased operating/manufacturing costs (2%) due to geopolitical events and labor shortages.
